title: Talent Acquisition Recruiter (Temporary 6 months)
description:
This is a contractor position to provide services to a global company based in Brazil

Position Summary

If you are a Talent Acquisition Recruiter professional looking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you. In this role, you will deliver full-cycle recruiting services that help attract, engage, and hire top talent across a complex business environment in the Brazilian market. You will partner closely with hiring leaders, HR colleagues, and candidates to develop effective talent strategies, build diverse talent pipelines, and ensure a positive recruitment experience. This position offers the opportunity to influence hiring outcomes through data-driven decision-making, strong stakeholder partnerships, and a commitment to operational excellence, innovation, integrity, collaboration, and inclusion.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

  • Develop and execute recruitment and sourcing strategies that align with business objectives and workforce planning needs.
  • Build and maintain diverse talent pipelines using a variety of sourcing channels, market research, and industry insights.
  • Provide full-cycle recruiting support, including job posting creation, candidate sourcing, screening, interviewing, selection, offer management, and onboarding coordination.
  • Partner with hiring managers and HR teams to define role requirements, assess talent needs, and recommend effective hiring strategies.
  • Leverage recruitment technologies, analytics, and reporting tools to improve recruiting effectiveness, optimize processes, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Promote and represent the Emerson employer brand to attract high-quality talent.
  • Participate in talent acquisition projects, initiatives, and process enhancements that improve the candidate and hiring manager experience.
  • Build and maintain productive relationships with hiring managers, HR professionals, candidates, and external partners.
  • Provide guidance on recruitment best practices, talent market trends, candidate assessment approaches, and workforce insights.
  • Foster engagement within talent communities to support current and future hiring needs.
  • Support training and knowledge sharing related to recruiting processes, systems, and tools.
  • Collaborate in the evaluation and management of recruitment vendors and external partners when applicable.
  • Ensure recruitment activities comply with company policies, employment regulations, labor laws, and applicable regional requirements.
  • Support governance processes, documentation requirements, reporting activities, and compliance initiatives to ensure a consistent and equitable hiring process.

Who You Are:

You anticipate customer needs and provide solutions that exceed expectations. You build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. You use data, insights, and sound judgment to make quality decisions, even in complex situations. You adapt your approach when priorities change and remain effective in evolving environments while maintaining focus on delivering results.

For This Role, You Will Need:

  • Experience managing full-cycle recruitment activities, including sourcing, assessment, selection, and offer processes for Brazilian market
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant professional experience.
  • Professional proficiency in English and Portuguese
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to build effective partnerships with stakeholders across multiple levels of the organization.
  • Ability to gather, analyze, interpret, and communicate data-driven insights and recommendations.
  • Knowledge of employment practices, labor regulations, equitable hiring principles, and inclusive recruitment strategies.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality results.
  • Experience driving process consistency and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Excellent relationship-building, communication, and customer service skills.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively with hiring managers, candidates, and cross-functional partners.
  • Experience using applicant tracking systems, sourcing platforms, and recruitment technologies, such as Oracle Recruiting Cloud, LinkedIn, or similar tools.

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:

  • Training or certification in behavioral interviewing, candidate assessment, or talent acquisition best practices.
  • Experience recruiting for technical, specialized, or professional roles.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
  • Experience analyzing recruiting metrics and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage recruitment data accurately and efficiently.
  • Experience supporting recruitment initiatives across multiple business units, functions, or geographic regions.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Why Valmont

We're Here to Move the World Forward.

Valmont impacts millions of people around the world every day, yet they might not realize the many ways. Our technology is helping feed the growing population, supplying the world with more reliable energy and access to renewables, enhancing connectivity in remote and urban locations to create a sustainable future and so much more. Simply put, Valmont is advancing agricultural productivity and reimagining vital infrastructure to make life better.

Join a Fortune 1000 company that respects hard work, honors diversity and invests in our employees as we focus on creating the world of tomorrow, today. We are the modern workforce. Are you ready to move the world forward? Apply now.

Brief Summary of Position:

The Human Resources Manager is responsible for leading the full spectrum of Human Resources activities for the business unit, acting as a strategic business partner to leaders while ensuring operational excellence and compliance with corporate policies and local legislation.

This role drives organizational effectiveness by leading talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, payroll oversight, employee relations, leadership development, performance management, succession planning, workforce planning, labor relations, compliance, and employee engagement initiatives. The position also partners closely with corporate HR Centers of Excellence and business leadership to align people strategies with organizational objectives.

The HR Manager ensures compliance with labor legislation, corporate governance standards, and Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) requirements while fostering a high-performance culture focused on continuous improvement, operational excellence, and employee development. The HR Manager will lead and develop the local HR team, ensuring high performance and capability building.

Essential Functions:

Strategic HR Business Partnership

  • Partner with business leaders to develop and execute people strategies aligned with organizational goals.
  • Provide coaching and guidance to managers on leadership, organizational design, talent management, employee relations, and performance.
  • Support organizational transformation, change management initiatives, and workforce planning.
  • Develop and implement HR policies, procedures, and best practices aligned with corporate guidelines and local legislation.

Talent Management

  • Lead talent acquisition activities, including recruitment strategy, selection, onboarding, and workforce planning.
  • Drive Performance Management, Talent Review, Succession Planning, Individual Development Plans (IDPs), and employee survey action planning.
  • Coordinate leadership development initiatives and training programs to strengthen organizational capabilities.
  • Manage internship and early career programs, ensuring development and succession pipeline.

Compensation, Benefits & Payroll

  • Oversee payroll administration, ensuring compliance with legal requirements and corporate standards.
  • Manage salary structures, job evaluations, compensation reviews, incentive programs, and annual merit processes.
  • Partner with Corporate Compensation on job grading and organizational structure.
  • Review and optimize employee benefits programs considering market competitiveness and cost effectiveness.
  • Manage the HR budget, headcount planning (AOP), labor costs, and workforce analytics.

Employee Relations & Labor Compliance

  • Monitor labor legislation and recommend proactive actions to minimize legal exposure.
  • Partner with Legal to manage labor litigation and develop strategies to mitigate legal risk and financial exposure.
  • Lead labor relations activities, including collective bargaining negotiations in partnership with Legal.
  • Ensure full compliance with labor, social security, tax, and statutory obligations.
  • Support investigations, disciplinary actions, conflict resolution, and employee engagement initiatives.

HR Operations & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with payroll, timekeeping, attendance management, and statutory reporting.
  • Monitor HR metrics and KPIs. Leverage HR analytics to drive data-informed decisions related to turnover, absenteeism, overtime, engagement, recruitment effectiveness, and organizational health.
  • Maintain HR processes, systems, records, and documentation in accordance with internal controls and audit requirements.
  • Support internal and external audits.
  • Support the global data privacy program by partnering with the Global Data Privacy Program Management team to ensure HR practices, systems, and vendor relationships comply with LGPD and other applicable data privacy and governance requirements.

Health, Safety & Well-being

  • Partner with EHS leadership to promote a strong safety culture.
  • Support occupational health initiatives, wellness programs, legal compliance, and workplace safety practices.
  • Ensure HR processes align with Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) standards and corporate requirements.

Required Qualifications:

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology or related field.
  • Postgraduate degree or MBA is preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive Human Resources experience.
  • Experience in multinational manufacturing or industrial environments.
  • Experience supporting senior leadership teams.
  • Proven experience leading strategic and operational HR initiatives.

Technical Knowledge

  • Brazilian Labor Legislation (CLT)
  • Payroll Administration and Labor Compliance
  • Compensation & Benefits
  • Performance Management
  • Talent Acquisition
  • Learning & Development
  • Organizational Development
  • Workforce Planning
  • Employee Relations
  • Labor Union Negotiations
  • HR Analytics & KPIs
  • Budget and Financial Management
  • Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS)
  • HRIS systems and Microsoft Office

Languages:

  • Fluent English (mandatory).

title: Consultor de Negócios Sênior
description:
O desafio

Você vai conduzir, no dia a dia, o diagnóstico ponta a ponta do ciclo Order-to-Cash no seguimento de educação, desde a matrícula até o fechamento contábil, investigando por evidências os processos, controles e a governança que contribuíram para apontamentos de auditoria externa. O trabalho cobre um ambiente multi-marcas e multi-BUs, com handoffs complexos entre CSC, Faturamento e Contabilidade, e inclui o ciclo de financiamentos estudantis (FIES e PAI/CREDIN). Você transforma os achados em matriz de causas-raiz e roadmap priorizado, com reporte ao Gerente de Negócios.

O que você vai fazer

  • Conduzir entrevistas com pontos focais e mapear o macroprocesso do OTC por BU e marca, identificando gatilhos de receita, desvios de execução, retrabalhos e processos informais que ocorrem em paralelo
  • Catalogar falhas ativas de controle, exceções de faturamento e pontos de pressão no fechamento contábil mensal, validando os achados em workshops com os atores operacionais
  • Desenhar e executar testes de estresse orientados por evidências (ex.: transações com descontos retroativos e movimentações fora das regras) para comprovar quebras de processo e de controle
  • Mapear papéis, alçadas e handoffs entre as áreas do ciclo de receita, estruturando matriz RACI, fóruns de decisão, SLAs, regras de escalonamento e ritos de acompanhamento
  • No ciclo dos financiamentos (FIES e PAI/CREDIN): mapear concessão, aditamentos, repasses e baixas, levantar regras de negócio e critérios de composição, e validar os saldos frente às evidências junto à governança
  • Consolidar gaps, riscos e causas-raiz em matriz única priorizada, indicando quick wins, controles compensatórios e medidas transitórias
  • Desdobrar as causas-raiz em iniciativas e estruturar o roadmap em ondas, com responsáveis, dependências e critérios de aceite, co-facilitando os fóruns executivos de validação

O que procuramos

  • Experiência, com pelo menos 2 em consultoria estratégica ou de gestão, ou em áreas de processos, controles internos, auditoria ou governança corporativa
  • Vivência comprovada em mapeamento de processos ponta a ponta, matriz de riscos e controles, segregação de funções e redesenho de rotinas financeiras (receita, faturamento, contas a receber)
  • Familiaridade com o ciclo Order-to-Cash e com rotinas de fechamento contábil; conhecimento de ERP (Protheus é diferencial)
  • Excel avançado e PowerPoint executivo: transformar evidência em narrativa clara para Diretoria e C-Level
  • Postura executiva e capacidade de conduzir entrevistas e workshops com múltiplas áreas
  • Experiência no setor de educação ou em operações B2C de alta recorrência é diferencial
  • Inglês avançado

Contratação: PJ + benefícios (plano médico, odontológico, alimentação, seguro de vida, bem - estar)

Modelo Híbrido: São Paulo - Capital.

title: Regional Sales Manager-Personal Protective Equipment
description:
Company overview

Kingwill Advanced Materials is a global innovator in high-performance polymer and flash-spun material technologies, providing advanced material solutions across industrial protection, healthcare, technical textiles, semiconductor, packaging, and sustainable applications.

Driven by innovation and scalable manufacturing capabilities, we deliver application-oriented B2B solutions to customers worldwide through industrial and distribution networks.

Mission of the Role:

We are seeking an experienced sales professional to drive business development for protective garments and apparel solutions — spanning both material inputs for garment manufacturing and a portfolio of finished protective clothing.

The ideal candidate combines deep industry knowledge of protective apparel with strong commercial capabilities, helping customers identify the most appropriate solution for their performance, regulatory, and supply chain requirements.

Key responsibilities

Business development

  • Develop new opportunities with garment manufacturers, converters, distributors, and end users
  • Expand brand presence in protective apparel, disposable garments, and technical clothing markets

Portofolio Sales

  • Promote and sell the branded materials used in the production of protective garments;
  • Develop sales of protective garments portfolio;
  • Work with customers to determine the most appropriate solution based on performance, supply chain, and regulatory considerations

Technical support

  • Advise customers on material selection and garment performance requirements;
  • Support discussions regarding fabric performance, barrier properties, and garment manufacture;
  • Assist customers with product trials and garment evaluations

Market development

  • Monitor market trends in protective clothing, disposable garments, and technical textiles;
  • Identify new applications and growth opportunities for garment products;
  • Provide market insights to internal product and development teams;

Customer engagement

  • Build relationships with garment manufacturers, distributors, and procurement teams;
  • Deliver product presentations and technical information related to garment performance and material properties;
  • Support customers during product evaluation and onboarding processes;

Technical Knowledge and Skills:

  • Minimum 5+ years experience in sales or business development related to:
  • protective garments
  • disposable apparel
  • PPE products
  • technical textiles or nonwoven materials
  • Experience working with garment manufacturers, distributors, or PPE brands;
  • Understanding of materials used in protective clothing, including nonwoven materials, laminates, or technical fabrics;
  • Strong commercial and relationship-building skills;

Preferred skills

  • Experience selling finished protective garments or PPE products;
  • Knowledge of protective clothing standards and performance requirements;
  • Experience in technical textile or nonwoven materials markets;
  • Technical background in textiles, materials science, or polymer engineering;

title: Supervisor(a) de Frota

Missão da posição

Principais responsabilidades

Gestão e disponibilidade da frota

  • Garantir disponibilidade dos veículos conforme demanda operacional;
  • Acompanhar alocação e utilização dos veículos entre operações e bases;
  • Identificar veículos subutilizados e atuar na redução da ociosidade;
  • Controlar entrada, transferência, substituição e desmobilização de veículos;
  • Manter inventário e cadastro da frota atualizados.

Manutenção

  • Gerenciar manutenção preventiva e corretiva;
  • Criar e garantir cumprimento do plano de manutenção preventiva por veículo;
  • Controlar quilometragem e gatilhos de revisão;
  • Acompanhar veículos parados em oficinas e cobrar prazos dos fornecedores;
  • Aprovar e auditar orçamentos de manutenção;
  • Analisar reincidência de defeitos e custo por veículo;
  • Desenvolver e negociar fornecedores, oficinas e prestadores;
  • Atuar diretamente na redução do tempo médio de manutenção e indisponibilidade.

Custos e eficiência

  • Acompanhar custo total da frota e custo individual por veículo;
  • Construir e acompanhar orçamento mensal da área;
  • Controlar custos com manutenção, pneus, locação, combustível, pedágio, multas e demais despesas;
  • Identificar desvios e apresentar planos de redução de custos;
  • Avaliar economicamente manutenção x substituição/desmobilização de veículos;
  • Trabalhar com visão de TCO – Total Cost of Ownership.

Combustível

  • Controlar consumo e despesas de abastecimento;
  • Monitorar km/l por veículo, motorista, operação e categoria;
  • Identificar consumo fora do padrão;
  • Investigar abastecimentos incompatíveis, duplicidades e possíveis desvios;
  • Administrar fornecedores, cartões e sistemas de abastecimento.

Pedágios

  • Controlar utilização e custos de tags;
  • Conciliar veículos, placas e cobranças;

Multas e documentação

Gestão de terceiros e locadoras

Gestão de equipe

  • Desenvolver uma cultura de controle, agilidade e senso de dono.

Experiência desejada

title: Analista Comercial e Administrativo
description:
Analista Comercial e Administrativo Júnior

Local de Trabalho: Vinhedo – SP | Presencial

Regime de Contratação: CLT | Tempo Integral

Reporte: Gerente / Supervisor(a) de Operações

Sobre a Posição

Buscamos um(a) Analista Comercial e Administrativo Júnior para apoiar as rotinas comerciais, administrativas e operacionais da empresa no Brasil.

A posição terá contato frequente com clientes, fornecedores, transportadoras, despachantes aduaneiros e com a matriz internacional, apoiando principalmente os processos de vendas, pedidos, faturamento, compras internacionais, importação, logística e comunicação em inglês.

Procuramos uma pessoa organizada, responsável, comunicativa e hands-on, com interesse em desenvolver uma carreira em uma empresa internacional e em um ambiente dinâmico.

Principais Responsabilidades

1. Suporte Comercial e Atendimento ao Cliente

  • Elaborar propostas comerciais e cotações com base nas tabelas de preços e políticas comerciais da empresa;
  • Cadastrar, processar e acompanhar pedidos de venda no sistema ERP/CRM;
  • Conferir informações comerciais, condições de pagamento, disponibilidade de estoque e prazos de entrega;
  • Atender clientes por e-mail, telefone e videoconferência, fornecendo informações sobre pedidos, entregas, documentos e demais solicitações;
  • Apoiar o acompanhamento de devoluções, reclamações e solicitações técnicas junto às áreas responsáveis;
  • Manter atualizados os registros de clientes, pedidos e oportunidades no ERP/CRM;
  • Elaborar e atualizar planilhas, controles e relatórios comerciais e operacionais.

2. Compras Internacionais, Importação e Logística

  • Emitir e acompanhar Purchase Orders (POs) junto à matriz e fornecedores internacionais, principalmente na China;
  • Monitorar cronogramas de produção, lead times, embarques e previsão de chegada dos produtos;
  • Coletar, conferir e organizar documentos relacionados aos processos de importação, tais como Commercial Invoice, Packing List, B/L, AWB e Certificado de Origem;
  • Fazer interface com o Despachante Aduaneiro (Customs Broker), agentes de carga, transportadoras e demais parceiros envolvidos no processo de importação;
  • Fornecer informações e documentos necessários para os processos de DI/Duimp e desembaraço aduaneiro, seguindo os procedimentos internos da empresa;
  • Acompanhar o andamento dos processos de importação, incluindo eventuais pendências documentais, exigências fiscais e liberações aduaneiras;
  • Apoiar a conferência de informações relacionadas a impostos, despesas de importação, fretes e demais custos logísticos;
  • Acompanhar a liberação das cargas em portos e aeroportos e coordenar a entrega até a unidade da empresa;
  • Realizar cotações de fretes nacionais e acompanhar entregas junto às transportadoras.

3. Comunicação em Inglês e Suporte à Matriz

  • Manter comunicação diária, em português e inglês, com a matriz internacional, fornecedores e parceiros;
  • Participar de reuniões virtuais e presenciais em inglês, auxiliando na comunicação e no alinhamento das informações;
  • Apoiar, quando necessário, a comunicação entre colaboradores brasileiros e estrangeiros durante reuniões, visitas e atividades operacionais;
  • Redigir e traduzir e-mails, relatórios, atas de reunião, documentos e comunicações internas em Português ↔ Inglês;
  • Apoiar executivos e visitantes internacionais durante reuniões, visitas a clientes, fornecedores e demais atividades no Brasil.

4. Suporte Administrativo e Operacional

  • Apoiar as rotinas administrativas do escritório e da operação;
  • Realizar cotações e compras de materiais de escritório, copa, higiene e outros itens necessários para a operação;
  • Receber e despachar documentos, correspondências, amostras e encomendas por Correios, DHL, FedEx e outros prestadores;
  • Fazer interface com prestadores de serviços relacionados à limpeza, manutenção, TI, ar-condicionado e infraestrutura do escritório;
  • Apoiar o agendamento de viagens corporativas, reuniões e recepção de visitantes;
  • Realizar a pré-conferência de faturas de frete e outras despesas operacionais;
  • Atuar como suporte aos demais membros da equipe durante férias, ausências ou períodos de maior demanda;
  • Executar outras atividades administrativas e operacionais relacionadas à função, conforme necessidade da empresa.

Requisitos

1. Formação

Ensino Superior cursando ou completo em:

  • Administração;
  • Comércio Exterior;
  • Relações Internacionais;
  • Logística;
  • Letras / Tradução;
  • ou áreas correlatas.

2. Experiência

  • Desejável experiência de 6 meses a 3 anos em atividades relacionadas a suporte comercial, administração, atendimento ao cliente, processamento de pedidos, compras, logística, importação ou comércio exterior;
  • Também serão considerados candidatos em início de carreira que apresentem bom potencial de desenvolvimento e conhecimentos compatíveis com a posição.

3. Idiomas

  • Português: fluente ou nativo;
  • Inglês: intermediário a avançado – obrigatório, especialmente para comunicação por e-mail, reuniões e contato com a matriz internacional.

4. Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Pacote Microsoft Office, especialmente Excel, em nível intermediário;
  • Conhecimento de fórmulas, PROCX/PROCV, filtros e Tabelas Dinâmicas será valorizado;
  • Experiência com sistemas ERP/CRM, como SAP, Microsoft Dynamics ou similares, será considerada um diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de comércio exterior e importação, como Incoterms, NCM, DI/Duimp, documentação de importação, agentes de carga e procedimentos aduaneiros, serão considerados diferenciais.

Perfil Desejado

Buscamos profissionais que demonstrem:

  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Senso de responsabilidade e disciplina operacional;
  • Boa gestão de prioridades e prazos;
  • Comunicação clara e profissional;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar com diferentes áreas, culturas e países;
  • Proatividade e disposição para aprender;
  • Capacidade de acompanhar diversos processos simultaneamente;
  • Espírito de equipe e perfil hands-on.

Benefícios e Condições

  • Contratação CLT – Tempo Integral;
  • Salário compatível com o mercado e com o nível da posição;
  • Vale-Refeição / Vale-Alimentação (VR/VA);

  • Oportunidades de desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional;
  • Plano de carreira: Júnior → Pleno → Sênior;
  • Demais benefícios conforme política interna da empresa.

title: Professor de educação física
description:
Job overview

We are looking for an experienced and qualified Physical Education teacher to join our Primary Section P.E Department at our Botafogo Site. We are seeking a dedicated educator to focus initially on teaching UK Key Stages 1 and 2, promoting sportsmanship, teamwork, and students' overall well-being.

Responsibilities

  • Child Psychomotor Development: A deep understanding of body schemes, laterality, balance, and gross motor coordination for children aged 2 to 11 mainly.
  • International Curricula and Methodologies:
  • Familiarity with frameworks such as the EYFS (Early Years Foundation Stage) from the British curriculum
  • Familiarity in international curricula like the IPC (International Primary Curriculum), Cambridge Primary / International Baccalaureate (IB).
  • Understanding the Transition from Early Years to Key Stage 1 / Primary
  • A child-centered and play-based learning approach through movement and active games.
  • Differentiation and Inclusion: Ability to design activity stations that accommodate different physical maturity levels.
  • Introduction to Basic Game Rules & Sports Literacy: Ability to teach simplified versions of team sports (mainly volleyball, basketball, futsal and handball), cooperative games, gymnastics, track & field (athletics), and rhythm and movement.
  • Spatial & Tactical Awareness: Teaching children how to share space, understand boundaries, play offense/defense in simple games, and follow rules safely.
  • First Aid & CPR: Practically mandatory in international schools to manage safety during physical activities with young children.
  • Child Protection & Safeguarding Training: A standard required certification across schools with British or American international curricula.
  • Energy, Patience, and Empathy: Ability to lead high-energy classes while maintaining a safe, welcoming, and dynamic environment.
  • Classroom Management in Open Spaces: Skill in keeping group attention and maintaining discipline through clear rules in gymnasiums or outdoors.
  • Intercultural Sensitivity: Ability to work effectively with families and students from diverse nationalities and cultural backgrounds.

title: Analista de Recrutamento e Seleção Senior
description:

  • Mapear o mercado de engenharia (benchmarking salarial, mapeamento de concorrentes e pool de talentos) para antecipar necessidades futuras de contratação.
  • Apoiar projetos estruturantes de R&S, como programas de trainee/estágio em engenharia, employer branding e diversidade em áreas técnicas.
  • Garantir aderência dos processos seletivos às políticas internas de RH e à legislação trabalhista vigente.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e apoiar/mentorar analistas juniores e plenos do time de R&S.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo em Psicologia, Administração, Engenharia, Gestão de RH ou áreas correlatas.

  • Vivência em recrutamento full-cycle, incluindo sourcing ativo e headhunting de perfis técnicos especializados.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de entrevista por competências (ex: STAR) e técnicas de avaliação comportamental.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de ATS e sourcing
  • Conhecimento das principais funções, trilhas de carreira e nomenclaturas do setor de engenharia/construção/projetos.
  • Boa comunicação, capacidade analítica e habilidade de negociação com stakeholders de diferentes níveis hierárquicos.

Diferenciais (Desejável)

  • Certificações em R&S, People Analytics ou Employer Branding.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Autonomia e senso de prioridade na condução simultânea de múltiplas vagas.
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal e capacidade de influência.

title: Assistente de Planejamento de Demanda e Controle da Produção (PCP)
description:
Sobre Barentz

A Barentz é uma distribuidora líder global de ingredientes de alto desempenho para ciências biológicas. A empresa oferece ingredientes e especialidades dos principais fabricantes em todo o mundo, bem como suporte técnico de valor agregado, incluindo pré-mistura, mistura, formulação de ingredientes e testes de ingredientes em seus centros de formulação e laboratórios de aplicações de última geração na região EMEA, Américas e Ásia-Pacífico.

Fundada em 1953, a Barentz opera em mais de 70 países, com forte presença na Europa e na América do Norte e uma rede em rápido crescimento na América Latina e na Ásia-Pacífico. Com um volume de negócios de 2,5 mil milhões de euros, a empresa emprega mais de 2.500 pessoas em todo o mundo e serve mais de 25.000 clientes. Para mais informações visite nosso site:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Assistente de Planejamento de Demanda e Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP) para apoiar as rotinas de benefícios, controle de ponto, medicina do trabalho e processos admissionais.

Missão

Apoiar as rotinas das áreas de Planejamento de Demanda e Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP), contribuindo para a coleta, organização, atualização e controle de informações relacionadas a vendas, estoque, forecast, disponibilidade de produtos, planejamento de amostras, industrialização em terceiros e indicadores operacionais.

O cargo tem como foco dar suporte às análises e aos processos de planejamento, garantindo a confiabilidade dos dados, o cumprimento das rotinas estabelecidas e a integração das informações entre as áreas Comercial, Compras, Supply Chain, Operações, Logística, Qualidade, Produção Terceirizada e demais áreas envolvidas, assegurando o adequado planejamento e acompanhamento das operações produtivas e do abastecimento.

Desafios do Cargo

  • Apoiar a organização de dados de vendas, estoque e demanda com atenção aos detalhes e confiabilidade;
  • Manter planilhas, relatórios, bases de dados e controles operacionais atualizados;
  • Contribuir para o acompanhamento de indicadores como cobertura de estoque, ruptura, giro, produtos de baixo giro e disponibilidade;
  • Apoiar a preparação de materiais e informações para reuniões de planejamento, forecast e S&OP;
  • Atuar em interface com diferentes áreas internas, garantindo comunicação clara e acompanhamento das pendências;
  • Aprender e aplicar rotinas, sistemas, ferramentas e processos relacionados ao planejamento de demanda;
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos controles e fluxos operacionais da área;
  • Apoiar o planejamento e controle das produções realizadas em terceiros, acompanhando embarques, recebimentos e prazos de fabricação;
  • Garantir o controle e acompanhamento do fluxo de envio e retorno de materiais destinados à industrialização em terceiros;
  • Apoiar o planejamento e acompanhamento das amostras, garantindo disponibilidade, cumprimento de prazos e atendimento às demandas comerciais e técnicas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar a coleta, consolidação, atualização e conferência de dados de vendas, demanda, estoque, pedidos, disponibilidade de produtos e abastecimento.
  • Atualizar planilhas, relatórios, dashboards, cadastros e controles operacionais em sistemas ERP, ferramentas de BI e plataformas internas.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de planejamento e estoque, como cobertura, giro, ruptura, acuracidade, excesso, obsolescência, produtos críticos e itens de baixo giro.
  • Apoiar a preparação de informações para reuniões de forecast, S&OP, planejamento de demanda e alinhamentos internos.
  • Auxiliar no acompanhamento de solicitações de compra, requisições, ordens de produção, cronogramas e prazos de abastecimento.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e o controle das produções realizadas por parceiros terceirizados, incluindo envio de matérias-primas, acompanhamento da fabricação, recebimento e atualização dos saldos.
  • Monitorar atrasos, desvios, inconsistências e riscos de abastecimento, reportando as ocorrências às áreas responsáveis.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e o controle de amostras, garantindo disponibilidade de materiais e atendimento aos prazos acordados.
  • Manter organizados os históricos, documentos, registros, materiais enviados, materiais recebidos e estoques em poder de terceiros.
  • Atuar em conjunto com Comercial, Compras, Supply Chain, Logística, Operações, Qualidade, Marketing e parceiros terceirizados para garantir o fluxo adequado dos processos.
  • Contribuir para a padronização e melhoria contínua de controles, relatórios, fluxos e rotinas operacionais.
  • Participar de treinamentos e cumprir as políticas internas, procedimentos, normas de compliance, confidencialidade e governança corporativa.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior cursando ou completo em Administração, Logística, Engenharia de Produção, Comércio Exterior, Economia, Gestão Comercial, Gestão de Supply Chain ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejáveis cursos complementares em Excel, Power BI, Planejamento, Supply Chain, Análise de Dados ou áreas relacionadas.

Diferenciais

  • Desejável experiência anterior em rotinas administrativas, planejamento, controle de estoque, logística, supply chain, compras, suporte comercial ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável vivência com atualização de planilhas, relatórios, controles operacionais, conferência de dados, sistemas ERP ou apoio a processos de demanda e abastecimento.

Idiomas:

  • Português fluido.
  • Inglês básico desejável, especialmente para leitura de documentos, sistemas, relatórios ou comunicações internas, quando aplicável.

Modelo de Trabalho - CLT 100% - Presencial com 1 dia de home office;

Local: Avenida Angélica, Consolação - Estamos a 200m do metrô Paulista/Consolação (Linha Amarela/Verde).

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação no iFood Benefícios, com utilização na função crédito;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Plano Médico SulAmérica, sem coparticipação, com possibilidade de inclusão de dependentes diretos;
  • Plano Odontológico Porto Seguro;
  • TotalPass ou Wellhub, conforme adesão opcional;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR até 2 salários), conforme avaliação de desempenho e resultados da empresa;
  • Auxílio Creche para mães e pais, até o(a) filho(a) completar 2 anos;
  • Subsídio de estacionamento, conforme elegibilidade do cargo e local de trabalho;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Previdência Privada.

Por que Barentz?

Nos valorizamos um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e acolhedor, onde cada profissional tem espaço para aprender, crescer e contribuir com novas ideias. Vivemos diariamente o nosso propósito de construir relações de confiança e trabalhamos guiados pela nossa cultura de "One Team, One Goal", incentivando a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e o protagonismo de cada colaborador.

Se você busca fazer parte de uma empresa sólida, em constante evolução e que investe no desenvolvimento das pessoas, venha construir essa história conosco!

title: Analista de Projetos Sênior (Engenharia)
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Acompanhar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento, análise e validação de projetos de engenharia de saneamento.
  • Revisar e conduzir projetos executivos de engenharia.
  • Elaborar e revisar escopos técnicos, termos de referência e especificações para contratação de projetos.
  • Realizar análise crítica de soluções técnicas, garantindo aderência a normas, diretrizes da companhia e viabilidade operacional.
  • Estruturar e acompanhar cronogramas físico-financeiros de projetos de engenharia.
  • Apoiar a priorização e planejamento do portfólio de investimentos (CAPEX).
  • Conduzir reuniões técnicas com áreas internas, projetistas e fornecedores.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e executivos para a gestão.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Engenharia Civil, Ambiental, Sanitária ou áreas semelhantes.
  • Experiência em projetos de infraestrutura de saneamento ou obras de médio/grande porte.
  • Experiência prática em projetos e/ou interface com projetistas.
  • Conhecimento em dimensionamento de sistemas de água e esgoto.
  • Familiaridade com softwares de desenvolvimento de projetos (AutoCAD, Revit, BIM ou correlatas).

Informações adicionais

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 25.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Commercial Financial BP
description:
At Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies, our 8,000+ global associates are proud to come to work each day, knowing that what we do impacts the lives of patients around the world.

We make medical devices and related products that are used to collect, separate, manufacture and process various components of blood and cells. With our innovative technologies and service offerings, we touch a patient's life every second of every day and are committed to continuing to increase the number of patients we serve.

With some of the best and brightest minds in the industry, an unmatched global footprint, comprehensive benefits and a distinct culture, Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies is a great place to work, grow and be part of a team that is focused on making a difference. Consider joining our team and unlock your potential.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for a Commercial Finance Business Partner LATAM to support the commercial organization across the region and act as a key financial partner in business growth and decision-making.

This is a regional role with exposure to multiple LATAM markets, working closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Operations and other business stakeholders. The position will play a critical role in connecting financial strategy with commercial objectives, providing insights that support profitable and sustainable growth.

The ideal candidate will combine strong financial expertise with a genuine business mindset, the ability to challenge commercial decisions constructively, and the agility to operate in a dynamic, multicultural environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with LATAM commercial leadership to analyze business performance and identify opportunities to improve sales, profitability and operating results.
  • Prepare and evaluate business cases for customer transactions, new business opportunities and strategic initiatives, providing financial recommendations to support decision-making.
  • Analyze sales, margins, profitability, pricing and operating expenses, identifying risks and opportunities and recommending proactive actions.
  • Lead and coordinate budgeting, forecasting and strategic planning processes across LATAM, including variance analysis and management reporting.
  • Develop financial models and projections for new business opportunities, customer solutions, investments and strategic projects.
  • Support the commercial organization in evaluating customer deals, pricing strategies and profitability, challenging assumptions when necessary to ensure sustainable growth.
  • Prepare weekly sales forecasts and monthly reports and dashboards to provide clear visibility into LATAM commercial performance.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Operations and Finance teams across different LATAM countries, acting as a bridge between regional and global finance organizations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve internal processes, pricing competitiveness and financial efficiency across the region.
  • Support Sales and commercial teams with financial tools, analysis and training to strengthen business decision-making.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Education

• University degree in Economics, Finance, Business Administration or a related field. Accounting background is a plus.

Experience

  • 7+ years of relevant professional experience, ideally with 5–8 years in Commercial Finance, FP&A or Business Partnering roles.
  • Experience working with commercial teams in a regional or multinational environment.
  • Strong understanding of pricing, profitability, forecasting and financial modeling.
  • Experience working across LATAM or other emerging markets is highly valued.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced financial modeling and analytical capabilities.
  • Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting and P&L analysis.
  • Experience with pricing and profitability analysis.
  • Ability to translate financial and market data into actionable business recommendations.
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI.
  • Experience with ERP and financial systems, preferably SAP.

Business & Leadership Skills

  • Strong commercial mindset and understanding of business growth drivers.
  • Ability to influence decisions and challenge commercial strategies through data and financial insights.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to explain financial concepts to non-financial stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders across different countries and cultures.

Languages

  • Advanced English is required.
  • Spanish and/or Portuguese are highly valued for regional collaboration.

Location & Travel

The position will be based in one of Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies' LATAM locations, with a regional scope covering key markets across Latin America. Availability to travel within the region as required.

WHY JOIN TERUMO BLOOD AND CELL TECHNOLOGIES?

Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies is part of Terumo Group, founded in 1921 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

In 2024, Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies reached $1.5 billion in revenue.

We employ nearly 8,000 associates globally, with global headquarters in Lakewood, CO, U.S., and regional headquarters in Brussels, Buenos Aires, Singapore and Tokyo.

We manufacture devices, disposable sets and solutions at our facilities in Belgium, India, Japan, Northern Ireland, the U.S. and Vietnam. Our global presence enables us to serve customers in more than 130 countries.

Our core values help set our direction, guide our actions and keep us true to our corporate mission of contributing to society through healthcare.

  • Respect – Appreciative of others
  • Integrity – Guided by our mission
  • Care – Empathetic to patients
  • Quality – Committed to excellence
  • Creativity – Striving for innovation

title: BIM Modeler
description:
BIM Modeler – Fire Protection / Sprinkler Systems (US Projects) | Revit MEP | Remote Brazil

NEW REMOTE OPPORTUNITY FOR AEC PROFESSIONALS IN BRAZIL!

Work directly with leading US-based engineering & construction firms.

Competitive Pay in USD | Full-Time (NY Schedule) | 100% Remote (Brazil)

We are hiring a BIM Modeler / Specialist focused on Fire Protection & Sprinkler Systems (Sistemas de Combate a Incêndio) to join the design team of one of our U.S.-based construction clients in New York.

In this role, you will work directly with the client's engineering team to develop detailed fire sprinkler shop drawings, build 3D models using Revit MEP and AutoSprink, and ensure full compliance with NFPA standards. This is an ideal position for Mechanical, Civil, or Fire Protection Engineers in Brazil with hands-on experience in fire protection design (Proteção Contra Incêndio) and BIM coordination.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in Brazil directly for a U.S. client.
  • USD Compensation: Competitive rate with direct international payment.
  • Full-Time: Monday–Friday (New York / EST Schedule).
  • 18 PTO Days: Flexible paid time off for personal use.
  • Professional Growth: Direct exposure to U.S. building codes, NFPA standards, and advanced BIM workflows.

What You'll Do

  • Develop detailed 3D models and construction-ready shop drawings using Revit MEP and AutoSprink.
  • Design, model, and coordinate fire sprinkler and fire suppression systems for commercial and residential U.S. projects.
  • Apply NFPA standards (particularly NFPA 13, 14 & 20) to develop fully compliant, constructible designs.
  • Perform clash detection and spatial coordination with Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Structural disciplines using Navisworks.
  • Proactively review plans to identify design conflicts and develop practical engineering solutions before construction.
  • Conduct QA/QC reviews to eliminate modeling errors and maintain organized project documentation/revisions.

What You'll Bring

  • English Level: Advanced Technical & Conversational English (B2+ / C1).
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in fire protection design, fire sprinkler modeling, or fire suppression systems.
  • Core Software: Expert proficiency in Revit MEP (mandatory); strong experience with AutoSprink is highly preferred.
  • US Standards: Deep knowledge of NFPA standards (NFPA 13) and U.S. fire protection practices.
  • Education: Degree in Mechanical, Civil, or Fire Protection Engineering, Architecture, or equivalent practical design experience.
  • Location: Must be residing and eligible to work remotely in Brazil.

Tools & Key Skills

  • Tools: Revit MEP • AutoSprink • Navisworks • AutoCAD
  • Technical Areas: Fire Sprinkler Design • Fire Protection Systems • Combate a Incêndio • NFPA 13 • BIM Modeling • MEP Coordination • Shop Drawings • Clash Detection

  • Revit MEP Designer – Fire Protection

  • Sprinkler Designer
  • Engenheiro Mecânico
  • Engenheiro Civil

At Cresta, we connect top talent in Brazil with leading engineering and construction companies in the U.S. You will work as a dedicated, full-time member of our client's team, collaborating directly on real-world U.S. projects while Cresta supports your ongoing onboarding and HR experience.

Ready to model safer projects for the US market from Brazil? Apply now and elevate your career! Note: Only CVs submitted in English will be reviewed.

description:
Seu próximo desafio está aqui!

#SejaParteImportanteDeAlgoGrandioso #BeABigPartOfSomethingBig

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Buscamos um Business Controller Specialist para atuar como um Parceiro Estratégico de Finanças da Business Unit. Você será responsável pelo controle financeiro e pela tradução de dados em insights estratégicos, conectando P&L, budget, forecast, OKRs e métricas operacionais.

Responsabilidade e Atribuições:

  • Responsável pela consolidação e análise mensal do P&L, acompanhando budget vs. realizado e forecast trimestral. Identifica desvios, analisa causas e propõe ações corretivas em conjunto com Finanças e Operações;
  • Acompanha a saúde dos OKRs estratégicos, conectando objetivos a resultados financeiros. Prepara dashboards de progresso mensal/trimestral, identifica riscos e propõe ajustes, garantindo transparência entre estratégia e realidade dos números;
  • Analisa drivers de valor e métricas operacionais (engajamento, conversão, lifetime value, churn, custo de aquisição), construindo narrativas que expliquem o "por quê" dos números e o comportamento do negócio;
  • Mantém painéis de controle atualizados (Excel, BI tools) para rastrear KPIs críticos, consolidando dados de múltiplas fontes com consistência e preparando relatórios executivos mensais/trimestrais;
  • Produz análises, decks e documentos que sintetizam a performance da BU para COMEX, Board e Diretoria de Finanças, apresentando dados com clareza e conectando-os à estratégia;
  • Realiza análises pontuais — impacto financeiro de iniciativas, cenários de crescimento, avaliação de oportunidades e benchmarking — com rigor analítico e pensamento crítico;
  • Interage com o time de Planejamento Financeiro do grupo em temas como orçamento, forecast e alocação de recursos, garantindo que as perspectivas da BU sejam consideradas nas decisões corporativas.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Superior completo em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Vivência relevante em planejamento financeiro, orçamento, forecast, fechamento gerencial e análise de indicadores de performance;
  • Sólido conhecimento de princípios contábeis, com capacidade de analisar de forma integrada DRE, balanço patrimonial e fluxo de caixa;
  • Capacidade de construir e manter modelos robustos, incluindo projeções, análises de cenários e avaliações de investimento;
  • Habilidade de trabalhar com informações complexas de diferentes fontes, identificando os principais drivers e transformando dados em conclusões claras e objetivas;
  • Domínio avançado de Excel, Google Sheets, PowerPoint e Google Slides, com capacidade de produzir materiais executivos orientados à tomada de decisão;
  • Inglês avançado.

Informações adicionais:

Nosso modelo de trabalho é híbrido, com três dias presenciais por semana na sede do Santander, na Vila Olímpia. Um espaço colaborativo, moderno e cheio de conexões — onde ideias ganham velocidade e pessoas impulsionam o futuro.

title: Sr Sales Operations Manager - SMB
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Sales Operations Manager (IC) to join our team as the strategic engine behind our SMB merchant growth. Although this position carries a Manager title, it is a hands-on Individual Contributor (IC) role at the intersection of Sales Operations, Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy, and Analytics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect end-to-end merchant journey systems. Define clear entry/exit criteria, operational SOPs, and category-specific methodologies to drive merchant performance and BD team efficiency.
  • Write custom SQL queries to extract data, build tracking models, monitor key operational metrics for anomalies, and proactively uncover market opportunities without relying on external analytics teams.
  • Partner directly with Product and Growth teams to secure priority exposure, subsidy budgets, and strategic campaign placements for SMB merchants.
  • Conduct research into restaurant unit economics, menu composition, gross margins, menu design, and business workflows to distill strategic insights into practical operational checklists for BDs.
  • Formulate strategic recommendations, continuously refine SOPs, and deliver training and enablement materials that turn complex operational methodologies into high-impact sales execution.

Job Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Commercial Strategy, or Business Analytics within SMB SaaS, FoodTech, or Marketplace environments.
  • Strong, hands-on experience querying large datasets with SQL to perform root-cause analysis, measure business impact, and drive data-informed strategies.
  • Proven track record of combining sales operations with GTM strategy—identifying key leverage points in sales processes and exploring innovative partnership/commercial models around market trends.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business logic into clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), structured playbooks, and training programs for BD/Sales teams.
  • Excellent logical thinking, communication skills, and cross-departmental collaboration abilities (connecting Sales, Product, Growth, and Marketing).
  • Proficiency in English

Keeta Brazil is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities (PwD). If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know - we are here to support you.

title: Integration Architect
description:
Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning

At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.

This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.

Integration Architect

At o9, we invest in people. We seek talented, driven individuals to power our transformative approach. You'll thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment, growing while making a real impact.

What you'll do for us

  • Design, build and deploy effective SSIS packages to validate, synthesize, transform customer data for integrated business planning and analytics.
  • Understand o9 platform's data model (table structures, linkages, optimal designs) for designing various planning use cases.
  • Review and analyze the data provided by customers along with its technical/functional intent and interdependencies.
  • Lead customer sessions in the technical design, data requirements gathering and making recommendations on best practices, in case of inaccurate or missing data.
  • Design and automate the data loading and insights generation process with intelligent checks and balances for sustained value delivery.
  • Design and support execution of test plans, document issues and track progress at resolving issues.

What you'll have

Experience:

  • 8+ Years. Experience with planning applications.
  • Experience in building scalable ML frameworks by identifying and collecting relevant input data, feature engineering, tuning, and testing.
  • ETL development with at least 1 year in designing ETL solutions for clients is a MUST.
  • (SSIS is preferred)
  • Experience in Creating/Testing Web API via Postman /C#/ JavaScript.
  • Good to have experience working with Hive/Hadoop/Python.
  • Knowledge and experience in Apache NiFi / Apache Airflow.
  • Prior work experience on Supply chain.
  • Strong experience in Cloud Data Quality, Source Systems Analysis, Business Rules Validation, Source Target Mapping Design, Performance Tuning and High-Volume Data Loads.
  • Education: BE/Btech/Mtech/MCA.

Skills:

  • Languages: SQL , MDX, T-SQL with knowledge of DDL, DML, stored procedures, triggers and performance tuning is a must. Leveraging ETL tools like SSIS for data transformations. Python, Bash, and/or Powershell Scripting; Amazon Web Services (AWS), AZURE, Google Cloud Infrastructures preferred.
  • Some Knowledge of C# /JavaScript / VB.NET or analytical packages like R is desirable.
  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Excel/PowerPoint /Visio for analysis and presentation
  • Knowledge on handling JSON files, Serializing the data, Posting data to API is desirable.
  • Strong Technical and communications skills.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary – We recognize and reward talent.
  • Tech Tools – Choose a Windows or PC laptop, whatever helps you work best.
  • Flexible Work – Work from home two days a week—less commuting, more time for what matters.
  • Supportive Team – Work alongside a diverse, talented team you can learn from every day.
  • Diversity & Inclusion – We celebrate our international workforce and value different perspectives.
  • Food & Drink – Enjoy healthy snacks, fresh fruit, teas, and coffees.

How the process works

  • Apply – Submit your application by clicking the Link below.
  • Initial Contact – Our recruiter will connect with you via video or phone call to discuss the role and understand your background.
  • Online Assessment - (If Applicable)
  • Tech Round 1 – An initial technical discussion to evaluate your skills and expertise.
  • Tech Round 2 – A deeper technical assessment to understand your approach and proficiency.
  • Managerial Round – A conversation with the hiring manager to evaluate collaboration, team fit, and growth potential.
  • HR Round – A final discussion on company culture, expectations, and career progression.

More about us...

At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.

With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. Through our aim10x vision, we are committed to AI-powered management, driving 10x improvements in enterprise decision-making. Our Enterprise Knowledge Graph enables businesses to anticipate risks, adapt to market shifts, and gain real-time visibility. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.

o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

title: Regulatory Science & Product Registration Lead (Seeds & Traits)
description:
Position Overview

This role leads the technical writing, dossier compilation, and procedural management for genetically modified (GM) crops and gene-edited products (New Breeding Techniques - NBTs) in Brazil. The Lead will combine a process-driven mindset with solid scientific knowledge to draft regulatory submissions, manage Planned Environmental Releases (LPMAs), and author technical responses to CTNBio's official inquiries. Additionally, this position will drive regulatory intelligence and oversee VCU (Value for Cultivation and Use) trials required for variety registration with MAPA.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the preparation, technical writing, and assembly of scientific dossiers for commercial release and Planned Environmental Releases (LPMAs), ensuring full compliance with CTNBio standards.
  • Act as the technical lead for analyzing and drafting precise, science-based responses to official inquiries and data requests from CTNBio members.
  • Leverage a solid background in molecular biology to support regulatory strategies and technical rationales for gene-edited products, addressing official consultations for NBTs.
  • Oversee the planning, data alignment, and administrative requirements for VCU (Valor de Cultivo e Uso) trials, ensuring the bridge between CTNBio biosafety approvals and National Cultivar Registration (RNC) with MAPA.
  • Continuously monitor, analyze, and map changes in the Latin American regulatory landscape, competitive landscape (competitor pipeline), and evolving guidelines.
  • Interface with global R&D teams to translate, adapt, and validate global data into the standard format required by Brazilian authorities.

Qualifications

  • PhD in Biotechnology, Biology or Agronomy, with minimum of 5 years relevant experience; MSc with minimum of 8 years relevant experience with a focus on molecular genetics.
  • Proven experience in technical writing for biotechnology regulatory affairs in Brazil. Demonstrated track record in drafting CTNBio dossiers and handling official inquiries.
  • Deep, process-oriented understanding of CTNBio requirements, with solid experience evaluating complex molecular characterization data. This includes hands-on familiarity with southern blot analysis, next-generation sequencing (NGS), flanking sequences, allergenicity/toxicity profiles, and food/feed/environmental risk assessment data packages.
  • Familiarity with MAPA's administrative and legal frameworks, specifically regarding VCU (Valor de Cultivo e Uso) trial protocols, data alignment, and RNC (Registro Nacional de Cultivares) registration procedures to ensure the smooth transition from biosafety approval to commercial seed licensing.
  • Attention to quality and detail-oriented.
  • Efficient and timeline driven.
  • Excellent oral and written communication (including presentation) skills.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese is required for scientific data review and alignment with global R&D teams.

title: Analista Fiscal Júnior
description:
Sobre a Bip

Nascida em Milão no ano de 2003, temos uma história de crescimento exponencial. De 44 pessoas, hoje somos mais de 4500 em todo o mundo, presentes em 4 continentes e em mais de 14 países. Ao longo de todos esses anos crescemos significativamente e transformamos milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho!

Somos guiados por três grandes sonhos...

I. Ser a empresa que sempre sonhamos e que sonhamos para sempre

Espelha o desejo de evolução constante e perenizarão da empresa através de uma cultura forte centrada em pessoas e que essas pessoas pratiquem constantemente a ownership. Que para nós significa liberdade com autonomia de dono e responsabilidade pelo futuro da organização.

II. Presente em ecossistema inovador

Significa ter e desenvolver constantemente, internamente ou através de parceiros, soluções inovadoras que promovam impactos em nossos clientes e que sejam o pilar de nossa perenidade. Pois só um repensar constante nos manterá atuantes no mercado.

III. Socialmente Engajada

Conscientes dos aspectos sociais do nosso país, transformamos o nosso conhecimento, a nossa capacidade de execução e networking em impactos positivos e constantes.

Para realizar nossos sonhos, alcançar nossa visão e honrar o porquê existimos, precisamos fortalecer muito bem quem nós somos. Nunca esquecendo da nossa autenticidade e da nossa singularidade.

  • All Points (Programa de pontos para passagens áreas e hospedagens)

Requisitos

  • Formação em Contabilidade, Ciências Contábeis ou Administração;
  • Conhecimento em contabilidade básica;
  • Noções de tributos indiretos, incluindo retenções na fonte, ISS próprio e ISS retido na fonte;
  • Excel em nível intermediário;

SOMOS DIFERENTES DE TUDO O QUE VOCÊ JÁ VIU!

Somos uma consultoria internacional de transformação de negócios, fundada na Itália em 2003, há 20 anos impactando milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho.

A mudança é a base de nossa mentalidade, aprendemos e reaprendemos constantemente. Descrição do cargo

  • Executar processos de limpeza técnica e especializada em calçados, incluindo limpeza a seco, limpeza úmida, hidratação, impermeabilização e demais serviços oferecidos pela empresa;
  • Realizar higienização, conservação e acabamento dos calçados seguindo os padrões de qualidade da New Shoes;
  • Cumprir rigorosamente os protocolos de segurança, biossegurança e descarte adequado de materiais;
  • Organizar e manter a área de produção limpa, segura e funcional;
  • Controlar e organizar os insumos utilizados na operação;
  • Conferir a qualidade dos serviços executados antes da liberação para entrega;
  • Apoiar na limpeza, conservação e organização geral da loja;
  • Auxiliar no recebimento, identificação e movimentação dos calçados dentro da operação;
  • Apoiar o atendimento ao cliente quando necessário, especialmente nos processos de retirada e entrega dos calçados;

title: Staff AI Product Designer
description:
Build the future of payments with AI, Pix & Open Finance

Type: Full-Time

Language: English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

Reports to: Head of design

The Company

Nova is building a new generation payment network (i.e. reinventing Visa/Mastercard) using AI on top of Pix and Open Finance.

Its first product is a B2C digital wallet that functions as an infrastructure bridge between traditional credit cards and Pix, allowing consumers to use their existing credit card

limits anywhere, even to pay Pix and Boletos in installments.

The company was founded by an elite team of fintech veterans and has had top-tier venture capital investors (Monashees, Canary, Canaan and Propel) since its inception.

They recently raised a large Series A and are now assembling a small team of exceptional experienced professionals to build, launch and grow its next generation of products.

The Role

We are looking for an exceptional individual to help design, build and scale Nova's next generation of products, working closely with the founders and the greater founding team. We're looking for an outstanding product designer who will:

  • Lead the design of payment experiences for both consumers and merchants, across mobile apps and desktop platforms, from research to polished, shipped product.
  • Help shape Nova's product vision and design direction, influencing decisions beyond your own projects.
  • Raise the design quality bar across the product, mentoring others and improving how the whole team ships UI.
  • Operate as an important IC designer, partnering directly with founders and leaders on product vision
  • Build and evolve design systems ensuring scalable, accessible, and delightful UIs.
  • Prototype and test ideas rapidly, validating hypotheses with real users.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product and engineering to align design decisions with business outcomes.
  • Share work frequently in constructive design critiques and contribute to our design culture of openness and iteration.
  • Occasionally support brand and marketing initiatives (landing pages, campaigns) when your craft can raise the bar.

This is your chance to be a key player at work, working on challenging projects with significant impact, as part of a select team of members at an ambitious and unique new payment network company.

The Qualifications

Required:

  • 7+ years designing digital products with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, including mobile interfaces.
  • Strong visual and interaction design craft with systematic thinking.
  • Daily use of AI in your design workflow (research, synthesis, spec'ing, prototyping).
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments, balancing high quality with speed.
  • Full professional proficiency in English

Preferred:

  • Experience building and shipping production-quality interfaces with AI coding tools (Replit, Cursor, Claude Code, v0, etc.), reducing or removing the need for front-end handoff.
  • Experience in fintech or payments in Brazil.
  • Background in early-stage startups, especially in 0→1 environments.
  • Familiarity with user research, testing, and product analytics tools (Amplitude, Metabase).

The Target Companies

Candidates with at least 2 years of full-time experience in the companies below will be prioritized:

  • Strong Fintechs: Nubank, Revolut, Wise, Mercado Pago, Brex, Itaú, Cora...
  • Strong Local Digital Product Companies: QuintoAndar, iFood, Wildlife, Mercado Livre, Globo...
  • Strong Design Consultancies: Work&Co, Metalab, Huge, R/GA, Accenture Song...
  • Big Tech: Google, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft
  • Other Tech: Notion, Netflix, Uber, Lyft, Airbnb, Spotify, Snap, X (Twitter), Pinterest

The Selection Process

Materials about Nova, including a pitch deck and pitch videos will be made available through the process

Portfolio Review: Async review of your portfolio by the design team to assess craft, depth of thinking, and end-to-end product work. Portfolio is required.

Screening Call: 15 min call with HR for alignment on requirements and qualifications.

Deep Dive Interview: 60 min call with Hiring Manager to deep dive on past experiences and profile.

Bar Raiser Interview: 45 min call with another leader to validate assessment with a 2nd opinion.

Cultural Fit Interview: 30 min call with CEO to evaluate culture fit and answer questions about Nova.

The Offer Package

  • Model: PJ
  • Compensation: aggressive salary
  • Stock Option: aggressive stock option grants
  • Other Benefits: premium health insurance, flexible hours, paid vacations and Wellhub

If you're excited about building the rails of the next generation payment network alongside a small team of high-caliber, highly motivated professionals, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Supervisor de Contas a Receber
description:
About the Company

CMA CGM is one of the world's leading transportation and logistics groups, operating across global markets and connecting businesses through integrated maritime, land, and air solutions. The Group is committed to innovation, operational excellence, sustainability, and the continuous development of its people and business.

Job Description

We are looking for an Accounts Receivable Supervisor to lead the company's accounts receivable and collection activities, ensuring that revenues are accurately and timely collected while maintaining appropriate credit policies and terms.

This position plays a key role in improving cash flow, managing credit and collection processes, reducing financial and operational risks, and strengthening relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Our opportunities are inclusive and open to professionals with disabilities (PwD).

Mission

The professional will be responsible for overseeing the Accounts Receivable function, ensuring effective credit management, collection performance, and cash flow optimization. The role will lead the team, monitor key performance indicators, identify risks and improvement opportunities, and ensure compliance with internal policies and Group procedures.

Main Responsibilities

Team Leadership

  • Define targets, provide the necessary resources, and manage team performance;
  • Develop and support team members to maximize individual and collective performance;
  • Ensure the team has the appropriate skills and profile for the area;
  • Oversee communication, instructions, and performance of outsourced collection partners;
  • Monitor productivity, quality, and target achievement across the team.

Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Develop and implement strategic objectives to improve cash flow and manage DSO;
  • Manage credit terms and ensure compliance with established policies and procedures;
  • Assess and approve credit within established authorization limits, supporting the CFO in credit assessments when required;
  • Manage collection activities performed by internal teams and outsourced collection companies;
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate financial and operational risks;
  • Ensure accurate reconciliation of accounts receivable balances in partnership with the Accounting team;
  • Maintain accurate records, reports, and performance information for key stakeholders;
  • Monitor KPIs and implement corrective actions whenever necessary;
  • Review and improve processes and procedures to enhance collection results and operational efficiency.

Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with Commercial and Invoicing teams to accelerate collections and strengthen customer relationships;
  • Partner with Finance, Customer Service, Legal, and Operations to resolve accounts receivable issues;
  • Support internal and external customers by negotiating solutions to outstanding issues;
  • Provide effective solutions to meet business requirements and customer needs;
  • Maintain stakeholders informed through accurate and controlled reports and information;
  • Act as a transversal business partner across different functions to improve cash flow and customer relationships.

Management Scope

  • Leadership of a large team of 7 employees;
  • Management of internal and outsourced collection activities;
  • Coordination of projects and initiatives related to credit and collections;
  • Interaction with senior management and cross-functional stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities & Expected Results

The Accounts Receivable Supervisor will be expected to maintain strong performance against the organization's KPIs, ensuring that accounts receivable remains under control and that collection targets are consistently achieved.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or a related field. An MBA is considered a plus;
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in credit authorization and accounts receivable/collection practices;
  • Previous experience in an Accounts Receivable leadership position;
  • Advanced Excel skills;
  • Knowledge of SAP is considered a plus;
  • Fluent English;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills;
  • Strong negotiation and problem-solving capabilities.

Key Competencies

Leadership | Financial Acumen | Results Orientation | Planning | Assertiveness | Teamwork | Negotiation | Problem Solving | Transversality | Conflict Management

Join Our Team!

Be part of a global organization where your expertise will contribute to improving cash flow, strengthening customer relationships, driving operational excellence, and supporting sustainable business growth.

title: Process and Automation Consultant (3 months)
description:
We are seeking a Process and Automation Consultant – RPA Specialist to join a three‐month advisory engagement that supports the migration of the core pricing system. The consultant will own the end‐to‐end documentation of current pricing and agreement processes, uncover manual pain points , and design automation‐ready future‐state workflows. The role reports to the engagement lead and works closely with operational teams , the client's internal stakeholders, and external implementation vendors.

Key Responsibilities

Document current‐state end‐to‐end pricing and agreement processes, including handoffs, exception paths, and workarounds. Quantify manual effort, cycle times, rework, and error rates using available data sources. Conduct structured process‐discovery workshops with operational teams to surface bottlenecks and improvement ideas. Identify and evaluate automation opportunities (RPA, workflow orchestration, rules‐based validation) and assess their long‐term viability. Design future‐state workflow alternatives that support agreement intake, validation, approval, and publication. Prioritize automation and redesign initiatives with effort, impact, and risk estimates. Distinguish automation that resolves root causes from automation that merely masks underlying process defects. Produce validated documentation and present findings to senior stakeholders for decision‐making.

Job Requirements

Minimum 6 years of experience in business process analysis, process improvement, or intelligent‐automation consulting. Advanced English proficiency (C1 level) with strong written and verbal communication skills. Proven ability to create process maps using BPMN, value‐stream mapping, SIPOC, or comparable

techniques. Hands‐on experience delivering RPA solutions with platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate, or similar. Demonstrated capability to lead and facilitate structured workshops with cross‐functional operational teams. Strong analytical skills to quantify manual effort, cycle times, and error rates.

Preferred Skills

Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification. Direct experience in pricing, rebates, or order‐to‐cash operations. Exposure to process‐mining tools such as Celonis or comparable solutions. Familiarity with workflow‐orchestration platforms (e.g., Camunda, Microsoft Power Automate).

title: Engenheiro de Dados Júnior
description:
